look_here_first: Treat this first as a taxon-concept card rather than a finished local key. Confirm current O. gilvescens identity before using historical phaeacantha labels, and prioritize pads, spines, flower, and fruit together when later diagnostic material is added.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flower color and structure should be paired with pad/spine traits

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruit characters should be used with vegetative traits

lookalikes.differences: Do not separate O. gilvescens from O. phaeacantha using an old label alone. Historical broad phaeacantha treatments are part of the confusion.
